question: Which narrowed follow-ups should OpenClaw core own from this bundled request, now that several sub-asks are already covered on current main?
rationale: The remaining work defines public setup docs, update report semantics, redaction boundaries, and audit coverage across security/auth/service surfaces; automation should not choose that product contract from a broad umbrella issue.

options.title: Split Core Follow-Ups
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and create or link focused core items for systemd SecretRef docs, update config-diff/safe-update design, and broader audit coverage.

options.title: Use Existing Canonicals
options.body: Treat the update portions as owned by #17215 and #14526, leaving this issue only for SecretRef docs and audit-scope decisions.

options.title: Defer Broad Audit/Safe Update
options.body: Document current `openclaw audit`, config audit, SecretRef audit, and update dry-run behavior as sufficient for now, accepting that the requested unified operator workflow remains outside core.

recommendation.title: Split Core Follow-Ups
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and create or link focused core items for systemd SecretRef docs, update config-diff/safe-update design, and broader audit coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: @steipete has the strongest observed cross-surface history across audit, published docs, dashboard/gateway helpers, and the prior keep-open review.
